gloss: chief editor; manager; person in charge

definitions.gloss: chief editor; managing editor; editorial director
definitions.explanation: The person who oversees and directs the editorial work of a publication such as a newspaper, magazine, or journal.
A senior staff member or executive responsible for managing a project, department, or organization. Used as a job title in government and some companies.

examples.japanese: {雑誌|ざっし}の{主幹|しゅかん}を{務|つと}める。
examples.english: To serve as the chief editor of a magazine.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{創刊|そうかん}から{長年|ながねん}{主幹|しゅかん}として{紙面|しめん}を{支|ささ}えてきた。
examples.english: He has supported the publication as chief editor for many years since its founding.

examples.japanese: {論説|ろんせつ}{主幹|しゅかん}が{社説|しゃせつ}の{方向性|ほうこうせい}を{決|き}めている。
examples.english: The editorial director determines the direction of the editorials.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{主幹|しゅかん}に{任命|にんめい}された。
examples.english: I was appointed as the project manager.

examples.japanese: {主幹|しゅかん}{研究員|けんきゅういん}が{報告|ほうこく}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The senior researcher gave the report.

examples.japanese: {県|けん}{庁|ちょう}の{主幹|しゅかん}クラスの{職員|しょくいん}が{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: Manager-level staff from the prefectural government office attended the meeting.

notes:
Compound of {主|しゅ} ('main; chief') and {幹|かん} ('trunk; core; key person'). Originally meaning the main trunk or pillar of something, the word extended to refer to the person who plays the central role in an organization or publication.

USAGE:
In journalism, {主幹|しゅかん} is a prestigious title, often higher than {編集長|へんしゅうちょう} ('editor-in-chief'). In government, it is a mid-to-senior rank between {課長補佐|かちょうほさ} and {課長|かちょう}. Usage varies by organization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {論説|ろんせつ}{主幹|しゅかん}: editorial director
- {主幹|しゅかん}を{務|つと}める: to serve as chief editor / manager
- {主幹|しゅかん}{研究員|けんきゅういん}: senior researcher
- {主幹|しゅかん}{教諭|きょうゆ}: senior teacher (government rank)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {編集長|へんしゅうちょう}: editor-in-chief — the more common title for the head of a publication's editing team
- {主観|しゅかん}: subjectivity — homophone with different kanji; completely different meaning
- {幹事|かんじ}: organizer; secretary — a person who arranges events or meetings, not an editorial role
- {責任者|せきにんしゃ}: person in charge — a general term for whoever is responsible
